up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1127197. A compound is considered reported in the document if it has a compound record (in the compound_records table) associated with that document (via doc_id). For each such compound, provide the following information: the compound's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the compound's preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), the maximum development phase (from molecule_dictionary.max_phase), the molecule type (from molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). The results should be sorted alphabetically by the compound's ChEMBL ID. Ensure that each compound is listed only once, even if it has multiple records in the document. Include all compounds, even if they lack a canonical SMILES (use a left join to compound_structures). The document is identified by its chembl_id in the docs table; join compound_records to docs via doc_id.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1127197' ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
